desc:
CRISPY CORN SNACKS: Bugles, the first cone-shaped corn snack; Made with crispy corn and contains no trans fat

HIDDEN VALLEY RANCH FLAVOR: Your favorite crispy cone-shaped snack now with the flavor of the iconic Hidden Valley Ranch

PANTRY AND PARTY FAVORITE: A pantry staple that's delicious alone or added to your favorite snack mix recipes; The ultimate snacking chips

ON-THE-GO SNACK: Perfect for the lunchbox or a grab and go snack as you head out the door; Adds satisfying flavor to snack bags or the office snack drawer

CONTAINS: 36 Travel Size 1.5 oz bags
features:
• A unique crispy corn snacks packed with flavor for snacking satisfaction and great for busting consumers salty cravings with a uniqe Ranch flavor
  • This convenient 1.5oz bag is great for vending machines, grab and go kiosks, or any snacking stations.
  • Zero Trans Fat and great for consumers looking for a healthier snacking option
  • Crispy corn snacks packed with flavorful snacking satisfaction and endless fun with America's #1 Finger Hat.
ingredients: Ingredients: Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Coconut Oil, Sugar, Salt. Contains 2% Or Less Of: Maltodextrin, Whey Powder, Monosodium Glutamate, Buttermilk Powder, Baking Soda, Dried Garlic, Dried Cheddar Cheese (milk, Cheese Cultures, Salt, Enzymes), Dextrose, Tomato Powder, Spices, Dried Onion, Citric Acid, Dried Enzyme Modified Romano Cheese (made From Cow's Milk, Cheese Cultures, Salt, Enzymes), Color (paprika Extract, Red 40 Lake, Yellow 6 Lake, Annatto Extract, And Turmeric Extract), Enzyme Modified Butter, Disodium Phosphate, Natural And Artificial Flavor, Disodium Guanylate, Disodium Inosinate, Nonfat Dry Milk, Butter (cream, Salt). Freshness Preserved By Bht. Contains Milk; May Contain Wheat Ingredients.
